historical: history/ contains earlier source epochs and observed failures; never substitute them for final qualification.
path_policy: Raw receipts preserve observed absolute execution paths. Portable instructions and final artifact paths are separate records.
mutation_snapshot_policy: Duplicated baseline_source trees omitted; exact snapshot manifests and mutation patches/receipts retained. First-party Git bundle preserves baseline/candidate source custody.
excluded_working_data: Native lane tmp directories, ephemeral pytest fixtures including deliberate symlinks, runtime caches, and owner lockfiles are omitted; actual receipts, captured outputs, journal/WAL/SHM, and reports are unchanged.
